title: The Word That Gets Shorter
summary: Check both the meaning and the spelling.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: I am a word. When you add two letters to me, I become shorter.
points: I am a word. When you add two letters to me, I become shorter.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Think about what the word means, not just how it looks.
points: Think about what the word means, not just how it looks.

steps.title: The method: Read the words literally
sentences: Add the letters 'er' to the end.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: The word is 'short'. Add 'er' and you get 'shorter', which means even less long.
The puzzle plays on the word meaning and the number of letters at the same time.
In word puzzles, check both what a word says and what it is.
